lookbackDuration.description:
Defined in number of seconds, this field represents the duration of historical data
required to run model inference for a timestamp `t`.
An example is a model which needs `t-4hours : t` duration of data to make a prediction
for timestamp `t`. In this example, {@link lookbackDuration} must be set to 14,400, i.e.,
14,400 seconds = 4 hours.

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

userUpdatedFields.description:
System managed field that keeps track of which fields in the seed data obj were updated by a user (as opposed to
the provisioner/authorizer).  Fields in seed data objs that are updated by users will not have those changes
overridden by provisioning.

hidden.description:
Field that marks a seed data obj as hidden.  When a seed data obj that was created via provisioning (e.g owned by
c3), user removals of that obj are handled by marking the obj as hidden to prevent future provisioning from causing
them to reappear.

userOwned.description:
A seed data entry is considered to be user owned if either this flag is true or the {@link Meta#created created}
field of {@link Persistable#meta} is not the authorizer or provisioner.  This field is completely managed by the
system.  It will be set while creating an entry if it is being created by the authorizer and the
{@link UpsertSpec#forceUserUpdate} is set to true.

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

frozen.description: If true, then the pipe shall not be retrained

trained.description: True if training has succeeded and false otherwise.

flattenInput.description: If true, the underlying model only accepts flattened input.

hyperparamOverrides.description: The hyperparameters overridden of a native model or pipe.

hyperparamSearchSpace.description:
A collection of {@link Hp.ParamSpace}s for the hyperparameters of this pipe. This search space will be used to
perform hyperparameter searches.

hpoSpec.description:
Used to provide configuration for {@link #search}. Some configurations include how to validate results, which
search algorithms will be used, and limits on execution iterations.

hpoExperiment.description: {@link Hpo.Experiment} stores the result of hyperparameter optimization to find the best model/pipeline.

experiment.description: Reference to the experiment that produced this {@link MlPipe}. For example, this could be a {@link Hpo.ExperimentBase}.

modelFiles.description:
Map of urls of saved model files
key - model file name, value - {@link Url} corresponding to model file name

customModelCode.description:
A map containing {Module Name: Compressed Source Code} key-value pairs. The module name is the name of the
module from where the source code was taken from. (i.e. numpy).

processFunc.description: Name for the function on the native model to call to do {@link MlProcessable#process}.

actionRequirement.description:
The {@link Action.Requirement minimal action requirement} in which all user-defined methods for the custom pipe
need to run.

isTrainableOverride.description: Set if user provides a `do_train` function.

nativeClassUrl.description: The url for accessing the saved native class source code

nativeInstance.description:
Serialized instance of custom, native Python class.
Allows for these classes to be stateful.

className.description: The name of the python class that contains the implementation of the ML algorithm.

childClassName.description: The `childClassName` property holds the name of the child class associated with the current entity.

inheritsFrom.description:
If the python class, {@link className}, inherits from or uses other classes, then the
names of these classes must be defined here. Important note: these "parent" classes
must be defined as instances of {@link ReliabilityMl.CustomPipeFactory}, first.

classKwargs.description: The keyword arguments required for instantiating an object of class, {@link className}.

convertSpec.description:
The {@link MlConvertSpec} used to instantiate an object of type {@link ReliabilityMl.CustomPipe}.
Specifies the conversion details for the data that will be processed by the custom ML pipeline.

is_interpretable.description:
A flag indicating whether the model is interpretable or not.
If true, the model's decision-making process can be explained and understood by humans.
If false, the model operates as a "black-box" and its decisions may not be easily interpretable.

trainedHyperparamValues.description:
Contains the values of "trainable" hyperparameters.
This field will be populated after the training of the pipe and includes parameters that can be adjusted
during training to optimize the model's performance.

title:
All ML algorithms in C3 AI Reliability MUST be represented as instances of {@link ReliabilityMl.CustomPipe}.
As an extension of {@link MlDynamicPipe}, this Type provides the flexibility to define the ML algorithms as
python classes in `.py` files rather than defining them as `.c3typ` files.
name: ReliabilityMl.CustomPipe
